QuestInfo.name: [Verne Mine] How Is My Father?
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2154004##k, the girl at the #b#m310050000##k in the Mine, has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154004# tells you it's been so long since she was captured, and she's curious about how her father is doing. She asks you to deliver a letter to her father. Deliver #t4032767# to #b#p2152006##k.

#b(If you lose the item, talk to Gabrielle.)
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the #t4032767# to #p2154004#'s father #p2152006#, the former Council President of Edelstein.
